subject: Two questions about Calmerol dosing and interactions
bodyText:
Hello,

I have two questions about Calmerol before I start taking it:

1. My doctor prescribed 10 mg twice daily, but the pharmacy label just says "take as
   directed" - can you confirm 10 mg twice daily (morning and evening) is the standard
   dosing for adults?

2. I also take an over-the-counter antihistamine occasionally for seasonal allergies -
   is there any known interaction between Calmerol and common antihistamines?

I haven't started the medication yet and have not experienced any issues - just want to
make sure I understand the instructions before I begin.

Thank you,
Sandra Whitfield
